entry.title: EvoGrain Uses L-Systems and Granular Synthesis for Algorithmic Sound Design
entry.content:
Lobsters Top | nathanho.me | discussion

EvoGrain is a rule-based system that generates audio using Lindenmayer systems (L-systems) and granular synthesis. The system utilizes an L-system to create command sequences for a "turtle" interpreter, which produces sets of grains defined by parameters such as pitch, duration, and amplitude. These grain sets are then synthesized into audio buffers ranging from a few seconds to 30 seconds in length.

Designed to produce raw material for sampling rather than complete musical compositions, EvoGrain employs an evolutionary optimization process to select the most musically interesting results. The architecture features a custom granular synthesis engine with phase modulation capabilities and a feedback delay network (FDN) reverb, using statistical analysis to guide the selection of optimal L-system rules.

entry.title: Amy Nicola McBride Updates Fishtail MIDI Generator to Version 1.1
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

Amy Nicola McBride has released version 1.1 of Fishtail, a generative MIDI instrument compatible with iPhone, iPad, and Mac. The update introduces two new composition engines: Lumière, which focuses on evolving modal color, and Ritual Engine, which utilizes repeating cells and shifting rhythmic accents.

Fishtail generates complete, repeatable musical forms using algorithmic rules grounded in music theory rather than generative AI. The software features a dice-roll mechanic to create shaped musical recipes, which users can then explore, edit, and arrange.

entry.title: UVI Rebrands Workstation as Player and Introduces Builder Platform
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

UVI has rebranded its UVI Workstation software as UVI Player and introduced the UVI Builder Platform. The UVI Player now supports Falcon Expansions and allows users to play UVI soundware and partner instruments, such as those from Acousticsamples and VI Labs, as a standalone application or DAW plugin.

The UVI Builder Platform provides partner brands with access to the Falcon engine's sampling, synthesis, and Lua scripting technology, managing deployment and copy protection via the UVI Portal. This enables third-party instruments to be playable in both the full Falcon environment and the free UVI Player.

entry.title: Bitwig Integrates with AlphaTheta’s rekordbox
entry.content:
MusicTech | musictech.com | source

Bitwig Studio version 6.1.4 now features integration with AlphaTheta’s rekordbox, enabling users to import DJ libraries and track analysis data directly into the DAW. When tracks are opened, Bitwig automatically applies the track's BPM, key, hot cues, song structure, and vocal positions to the project, facilitating easier remixing and production workflows.

The partnership also includes the launch of AlphaTheta's Studio Plan, a subscription service providing Bitwig Studio Essentials. Additionally, Bitwig has announced that built-in stem separation is expected to arrive in Bitwig Studio later this winter.

entry.title: All The Machines Releases UN/T-01 Free 808 Drum Machine Plugin
entry.content:
Bedroom Producers Blog | bedroomproducersblog.com | source | discussion

All The Machines has released UN/T-01, a free drum machine plugin featuring synthesized 808 sounds and sample playback capabilities. The tool includes a built-in step sequencer and provides six tracks for kick, snare, hi-hat, percussion, tom, and cymbal sounds.

Users can choose between the integrated synthesized 808 engines or load their own custom samples into the tracks. The plugin is currently in public beta and is compatible with both Windows and macOS.

entry.title: Aeons Light Releases Harmonic EQ
entry.content:
Bedroom Producers Blog | bedroomproducersblog.com | source | discussion

Harmonic EQ is a pitch-tracking parametric equalizer for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Available in VST3, CLAP, and AU formats, the plugin dynamically adjusts frequency content in response to changing musical pitch.

The software is distributed as a full-featured free trial that does not expire. Although all audio processing capabilities are accessible, the user interface includes a countdown screen.

entry.title: Synthius Labs Releases nob Prompt-Driven Wavetable Synthesizer
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

nob is a wavetable synthesizer for macOS and Windows that generates editable instrument patches from text prompts. Instead of producing rendered audio files, the plugin translates written sound descriptions into playable synthesizer parameters—such as oscillators, filters, and envelopes—that can be manually adjusted or refined through follow-up prompts.

The software is available in AU and VST3 formats for macOS and VST3 for Windows. It is offered via a $7.99 monthly subscription following a seven-day trial, and requires an internet connection to facilitate the prompt generation feature.

entry.title: Ocean Swift Releases Ocean Pigments Expansion for Arturia Pigments
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

This expansion for Arturia Pigments provides over 1,030 seamlessly looped samples, 890 wavetables, 280 noisetables, and 175 presets. The collection covers a wide range of melodic sounds, including ambient atmospheres, pads, and synth leads with Aftertouch and Modwheel support.

The expansion includes an "Open Library" feature, allowing the samples, wavetables, and noisetables to be used in software other than Arturia Pigments. The package also features NKS support and is available at an introductory price of 27.99€ through October 27th.
